qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/raw-evidence-index.json (scope: no reward discrimination/ranking or judge run on these bytes)
evidence: tests/scoring.toml [weights] functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 with [floors] functional=0.05 and zero-weight gates, byte-identical in values to the frozen template scoring.toml and the SKILL.md delivery profile, so functionality carries 60% and the non-functional dimensions can contribute at most 0.4 of the reward. Within functional (weighted_mean, 16 binary criteria, sum 3+4+4+2+1.5+4+4+2+3+1.5+1.5+1.5+2.5+1.5+4+4 = 44.0, matching the comment at functional/judge.toml:37), the heaviest weights (4.0) go to the brief's core legal promises - wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes, search_and_transcript (a walls-and-retention.md section) and persistence - with walls-added-live and holds at 2.0, signin/client scope 3.0, edits 3.0, and ordinary chat behaviours (nested replies, formatting, links, unread, live updates) at 1.5; this follows the stated rule at functional/judge.toml:32-38 (core legal 2.0 per part, chat 1.5, small 1.0). No functional criterion grades style or structure; polish criteria are six equal 1.0 small interaction behaviours, and visual likert weights favour domain-relevant craft (matter_sidebar, retention_marks 2.0) over transcript_page/phone_chambers (1.0). score.py:47 requires functional > 0.05, i.e. at least 2.5/44 functional weight (a single 1.5 or 2.0 pass gives 0.034/0.045 and is zeroed), so a dead or near-dead app cannot farm the 0.4 polish/visual mass. Weak-app probe: perfect polish+visual with only nested_replies passing scores 0 (floor). A pretty app passing one 4.0 criterion scores 0.6*4/44+0.4 = 0.455, roughly level with an unstyled conforming app passing 75% functional (0.45); that edge case comes from the template-mandated 0.6/0.2/0.2 split and floor, which this task must preserve, not from task-chosen weights, and any app passing more than ~76% functional outranks it. Minor non-blocking observations: the rule comment does not spell out the 4.0 decomposition of three-part search_and_transcript, and hold_scope_and_release (7 steps, core legal) sits at 2.0 per the one-part rule; neither inverts the functional-over-craft ordering. Static weight analysis only; measured reward discrimination/ranking on these bytes is absent per raw-evidence-index.json scope and belongs to rows 40/42.
